MODULE 2.5 — CLINICAL OVERVIEW
Moderna, Inc. | BLA Reference: BLA-3344-39
Clinical Development Program Summary

Product: mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) — COVID-19 Vaccine
Applicant: Moderna, Inc.
Address: 200 Technology Square, Cambridge, MA 02139
Submission Date: 22 February 2026
Document Version: v3.0
Prepared By: Jason James, Regulatory Affairs
1. Introduction
This document constitutes MODULE 2.5 — CLINICAL OVERVIEW of the Common Technical Document (CTD) format as specified in ICH M4 guidelines for the biologics license application (BLA) of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) submitted by Moderna, Inc. to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The submission follows the eCTD format as required by 21 CFR Part 314 and FDA guidance on eCTD submissions.
2. Clinical Development Summary
The clinical development program for mRNA-1273 consisted of multiple Phase 1, Phase 2, and Phase 3 studies evaluating safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy in diverse adult populations. The pivotal Phase 3 study (COVE Study, NCT04470427) enrolled 29882 participants across the United States and demonstrated a vaccine efficacy of 94.0% against COVID-19.
3. Benefit-Risk Assessment
The overall benefit-risk assessment for mRNA-1273 is favorable. The vaccine demonstrated robust immunogenicity, durable protection, and an acceptable safety profile consistent with other approved mRNA vaccines. Serious adverse events were rare and the incidence was similar between the vaccine and placebo groups.
4. Conclusions
The totality of evidence from the clinical program supports the safety and efficacy of mRNA-1273 for the prevention of COVID-19 in individuals 18 years of age and older. A favorable benefit-risk profile supports approval of this BLA.
